rows.name: Trackingmechanismen zu nicht pädagogischen Zwecken
rows.input_needed: target URL plus product-context evidence in local documents or AGB/privacy/AVV URLs; human review if purpose remains ambiguous.
rows.automation_level: automated evidence aggregation; PASS/FAIL only when tracker absence, known non-pedagogical tracking, or explicit pedagogical-purpose context is available
rows.evidence_artifacts: result.json, Markdown/PDF report, capture.json, code_capture.json, document_capture.json.
rows.cli_api_availability: CLI: vidis check; reports: vidis-report report; API: FastAPI job endpoints for async runs; document URL/file inputs available in CLI.
rows.known_limitations: Pedagogical purpose cannot be inferred from browser signals alone; provide product documentation or treat ambiguous tracking/fingerprinting as MANUELL.

rows.name: Agent login and persona based flows
rows.input_needed: Test credentials, persona (SuS/Lehrkraefte), optional VIDIS Landesportal and navigation hints.
rows.automation_level: authenticated evidence collection automated, most judgements manual
rows.cli_api_availability: CLI: vidis check --agentic; API: POST /jobs with agentic=true.
rows.known_limitations: Login flows differ per product; credentials must be test accounts. Findings from the agent run never downgrade deterministic site results.

rows.name: Screenshot and visual inspection
rows.input_needed: Target URL and pages; optional visual review prompt is still external.
rows.automation_level: browser capture automated, vision judgement manual
rows.evidence_artifacts: capture.json contains DOM/network/browser signals; screenshots are not yet first-class report artifacts.
rows.cli_api_availability: CLI site crawl exists; API jobs exist for submitted checks, but no dedicated screenshot export route.
rows.known_limitations: Visual-only claims such as banner prominence or deceptive layouts still require human review.

rows.name: API authentication, job list, and ZIP artifact download
rows.input_needed: API keys (VIDIS_API_KEYS), results volume, artifact retention policy.
rows.automation_level: authenticated job API with discovery, job list and ZIP download
rows.evidence_artifacts: result.json, capture.json, code_capture.json, document_capture.json, agent_capture.json, report PDFs/Markdown.
rows.cli_api_availability: GET /discovery lists the available checks; all job endpoints require an API key.
rows.known_limitations: Artifact retention is not automated; old jobs stay on the results volume until removed.

rows.name: FastAPI document URL ingestion
rows.input_needed: AGB, privacy, and AVV URLs or local server-side document files.
rows.automation_level: CLI/API automated for local documents and HTTP(S) document URLs
rows.evidence_artifacts: document_capture.json and criterion notes from document analysis.
rows.cli_api_availability: CLI supports --agb-url, --privacy-url, --avv-url, and --document; FastAPI accepts document_paths plus agb_url, privacy_url, and avv_url.
rows.known_limitations: Remote document fetches are limited to HTTP(S); local document paths must exist on the API server.

rows.name: RDS-SPE-370 criterion mapping
rows.automation_level: conservative document classifier plus manual fallback
rows.cli_api_availability: RDS-SPE-370 is now in the active registry and emitted by document analysis for CLI/API result output.
rows.known_limitations: PASS/FAIL requires explicit Sponsoring/economic-interest evidence; absence remains MANUELL because semantic AGB review is inherently context-sensitive.
